title: Anomaliped
summary: ANOM'ALIPED, adjective [Gr. inequality and Latin pes, foot.] An epithet given to fowls, whose middle toe is united to the exterior by three phalanges, and to the interior by one only. ANOM'ALIPED, nou

inlines.v: ANOM'ALIPED, adjective [Gr. inequality and Latin pes, foot.] An epithet given to fowls, whose middle toe is united to the exterior by three phalanges, and to the interior by one only. ANOM'ALIPED, noun An anomalous footed fowl. [See the adjective.]
